blaze_farm.descripcion: Uses a blaze spawner in a fortress so blazes appear on their own in a controlled spot, instead of you hunting them down the corridors.
blaze_farm.notas: Besides rods it gives you lots of experience, so it also helps with enchanting and repairing gear.
pasos: Find a cage with flames inside in the fortress: that is the spawner.
Cover the whole floor around it with blocks, up to four blocks in every direction, so they can only appear where you want.
Leave a gap for them to fall into and stand below it, out of their reach.
Light up the rest of the room with torches so they can’t appear anywhere else.
Hit them from below as they drop. Remember rods only drop if you land the final hit.
blaze_farm.advertencia: Always crouch near the edges: there is lava under almost the whole fortress.
